## Introduction

This document visualizes the famous iris dataset using ggplot2.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(ggplot2)
```

## Scatter Plot

Let's create a scatter plot of sepal length vs sepal width:

```{r}
#| label: scatter-plot

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Iris Sepal Dimensions",
       x = "Sepal Length (cm)",
       y = "Sepal Width (cm)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Box Plot

Here's a box plot showing petal length distribution by species:

```{r}
#| label: box-plot

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Species, y = Petal.Length, fill = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Petal Length by Species",
       x = "Species",
       y = "Petal Length cm") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red", "blue"))
```

## Summary Statistics

Let's calculate some summary statistics:

```{r}
#| label: summary

summary(iris$Sepal.Length)
mean(iris$Petal.Width)
sd(iris$Petal.Lenght)
median(iris$Sepal.Widht)
```
